truth.title: SQL Injection
truth.evidence: SQLi in GET /users/v1/{username} (UNION, 5 columns) ... /users/v1/{username}: SQLi confirmed (finding 2).
truth.note: Terse: no response body quoted, but endpoint, technique and a column count that can only come from observed UNION behaviour. Weakest of the found rows; flagged.

truth.title: Unauthorized Password Change
truth.evidence: any user can change another user's password (PUT /users/v1/{username}/password) ... /users/v1/{username}/password: finding 5 (cross-user change, then restored).
truth.note: Terse: names the endpoint and outcome, and a restore step that implies the change happened. No request/response quoted.

truth.title: Broken Object Level Authorization
truth.evidence: /books/v1/{book_title}: no token -> 401. Token of name1 reading name2's book -> 200 with secret (BOLA, finding 6).

truth.title: Mass Assignment
truth.evidence: mass assignment of admin at /users/v1/register ... /users/v1/register: admin mass assignment confirmed.
truth.note: Terse: no response quoted, but contrasted in the same report with a negative mass-assignment test (book owner) so the check was real. Flagged.
